Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.1: Arranging a Meet-up with a Friend Visiting on Business
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from your close friend, Alex, who is coming to your city on a business trip next week. Read part of the email below:

"I am going to have a two-day business trip to your city next Friday, and I really want us to meet up while I am there! Would it be better for you if we meet at noon for lunch or in the evening at night? Also, could you suggest some nice and suitable places where we can sit down, eat, and chat comfortably? Let me know what you think!"

Write an email responding to Alex. You should write at least 120 words. You do not need to include your name or address.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 1.2: Feedback on Hotel Stay Experience
Nội dung chi tiết:
You have received an email from the Customer Relations Manager of Sunrise Hotel, where you stayed during your recent vacation. Read part of the email below:

"Thank you for choosing Sunrise Hotel for your recent vacation! We are constantly striving to enhance our guest experience. Could you share some thoughts on your overall experience staying with us? What specific aspect or service of our hotel did you enjoy the most? Do you have any constructive recommendations or feedback on how we could improve our facilities or services for future guests?"

Write an email responding to the hotel manager. You should write at least 120 words. You do not need to include your name or address.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.1: Pros and Cons of Self-Employment
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"In recent years, an increasing number of professionals choose self-employment or freelancing over working as a regular salaried employee for a company."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of self-employment. Provide specific reasons and examples from your knowledge or experience to support your answer. You should write at least 250 words.

Tiêu đề đề bài: Task 2.2: Advantages and Disadvantages of Using Motorbikes in Major Cities
Nội dung chi tiết:
Read the following statement:

"In many major cities, motorbikes are widely favored as personal transport due to their low cost and convenient parking, yet critics argue that they contribute significantly to air pollution, noise pollution, and traffic accidents."

Write an essay to an educated reader discussing the advantages and disadvantages of using motorbikes as a primary means of transportation in large cities. Support your arguments with reasons and examples from your knowledge or experience. You should write at least 250 words.
